about_the_game: Food Truck Monopoly is a simulation game where you step into the shoes of a food truck worker on a mission to manage a business. Navigate bustling city streets, take orders from demanding customers, cook up delicious meals under pressure, and keep your food truck rolling. Balance speed, accuracy, and $ management to stay ahead of the competition and survive as long as possible. Upgrade your truck, explore new neighborhood, and serve mouthwatering dishes to dominate the food truck scene!
